accepted_behavior: Normal Admin Dashboard card and authenticated navigation discover the Launch Status route.
The generated read-only projection uses the canonical Board hash and one explicit current milestone.
The surface shows objective completed/total progress, latest sanitized change, what works now, remaining work, exact blockers, safe routes, and one next executable task.
Inactive future milestones are ignored; activating an incomplete milestone contract fails closed.
No credential, private destination, customer data, provider link, or diagnostic control is projected.

validation.live_admin_discovery: Dashboard card and authenticated navigation verified
validation.live_projection: percentage, works-now, remaining work, exact blocker, safe routes, and next task verified
